profile.headline: Integrations Engineer | Software Engineer III at ChoiceLocal
profile.summary: Results-driven Integrations Engineer with expertise in AI-powered automation, full-stack development, and digital marketing technology. Skilled in API integration architecture, connecting CRM systems with multi-channel marketing platforms. Skilled in Python, PHP, JavaScript, Google Cloud platform, and data analytics.

positions.title: Integrations Engineer/Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Architected and maintain integrations connecting form leads from multiple digital marketing
channels to 20+ CRM platforms, ensuring seamless data synchronization for 100+ clients.
- Built a suite of internal tools using Python and Google Cloud Functions to automate workflows, resulting in significant productivity gains across development, marketing, and the operations teams.

positions.title: Web Developer, Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Develop and implement WordPress custom themes and blocks utilizing PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Integrate into various customer APIs for form lead flow integration
- Maintain and update multiple WordPress websites for clients
- Create a GitHub action to streamline coding updates
- Utilize Zapier to create workflows into various CRMs

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Utilize Magento and languages including jQuery, LESS, and PHP to maintain and build code for future use.
- Develop and optimize user-facing features for multiple websites ensuring speed and scalability remains.
- Communicate with both technical and non-technical team members and stay up to date on emerging trends and technologies.

positions.title: Web Development Student
positions.description:
- Developed skills in front-end programming such as JavaScript, AJAX, HTML5, CSS, React.js, and other technologies.
- Developed skills is back-end programming such as Node.js, Express, SQL, and PostgresQL.
- Participated in pair-programming with challenging weekly projects and pushed work into repositories using Git and GitHub.
- Gained experience in full-stack development including UX/UI design, RESTful APIs, version control, and deployment.

positions.title: Project Specialist/Chemist I
positions.description:
- Led R&D lab and chemistry development for the commercialization of patented IP.
- Performed quality control and quality assurance of all products platforms and defined/implemented procedures for product safety evaluation and consistency.
- Created a batch control and tracking system for all production inventory as well as for incoming raw materials.
- Trained, supervised, and advised OEM manufacturers to ensure proper scale-up of production and managed trouble shooting and debug.
- Responsible for file management and organization of all lab systems, formulations, and inventory control.
- Established team communications, documentation and procedures for internal and external partners to focus project implementation on time and on budget.

honors.title: Award in Analytical Chemistry
honors.issuer: Issued by John Carroll University Chemistry Department · Jan 2017

honors.title: Undergraduate Award in Analytical Chemistry
honors.issuer: Issued by American Chemical Society Division of Analytical Chemistry · Jan 2017
